findings.text: The gate reads RED on a first run only because specs/index.md is stale relative to the working tree until this review's own WARP-0410 spec is added to the index; check_generated.sh regenerates it (adds exactly the WARP-0410 row) and the gate is GREEN. Harness artifact, not a defect in the release commit.

Honesty confirmed independently: X8/X9 were genuinely never built (no spec or proof files), no live work item depends on WARP-0408/0409, and .warp/capabilities.yaml honestly labels approvals as mechanical-but-not-identity-attested. Removing O2/F2 hides no work claimed done elsewhere.

The term control plane still appears in the generic method and setup docs as an optional scaling concept explicitly framed as deferred, and in some specs as future/out-of-scope; these are legitimate generic-methodology references, not delivery claims.

summary: WARP-0410 is a legitimate, honest release. Independent adversarial review: pass_with_notes, 0 blocking. PLAN-0004 revision 4 cleanly descopes the never-built server-side control-plane and identity track (X8/X9, F2, O2) with a documented founder rationale; the surviving O1/O3/O4 -> F1/F3/F4 -> X1..X7 traceability is fully intact and validator-clean; the plan is released 7/7, release-check passes, plugin is exactly 3.0.0, and docs/method.md was correctly left unchanged (WARP 2.0 is tooling, not a method change). Full gate GREEN (selftest 760); the only wrinkle is the expected index regeneration for this review's own in-flight spec.
